Nora (CS): Heads-up: Verdant.AI reached out — product analytics team wants to onboard next month. They cited rising QPS from a new personalization flow (session-based embeddings + realtime scoring). Asking for a short ops checklist and any known blockers.
Ethan (AM): Good signal for expansion. Do we have their rough peak numbers? that'll determine Dedicated vs hosted recommendations.
Nora (CS): They provided a brief: personalization scoring ~320 rps peak, realtime scoring spikes to 90 rps, nightly embed ingestion ~150k docs, and they want p95 tail under 150ms. They also asked about canary best practices.
Linh (Eng): 320 rps sustained + tail SLO suggests we should recommend prefix caching, KV cache warmup, and possibly a small Dedicated pool if they want strict tail latency. Hosted with aggressive caching could work short-term. Quick sketch: ```personalization peak:320 rps
realtime spikes:90 rps
batch embeds:150k docs/night
SLO: p95 < 150ms```
Omar (Solutions): We'll capture model matrix: high-quality variant for personalization (rdx-4-ptq) and a faster quantized for realtime scoring (rdx-embed-small-quant). Recommend canary split 10% traffic initially, monitor error rates and latency, then ramp.
Nora (CS): Action items: 1) one-pager with recommended config + cost delta 2) onboarding playbook for new team 3) quick canary checklist. Can @Ethan handle pricing scenarios?
Ethan (AM): Yes — will prepare payg vs 3mo committed scenarios, and include a note about burst credits for hosted while they test. I'll also add renewal framing since this is clearly expansion-led.
Linh (Eng): Config snippet we can share: 
```yaml
deployment: hosted-or-dedicated (recommendation: staged)
model_routes:
  - personalization:
      model: rdx-4-ptq
      policy: quality-priority
  - scoring:
      model: rdx-embed-small-quant
      policy: latency-priority
batching: adaptive
kv_cache: prefix + session_id
warmup: kv_prefill: true
canary: initial_split: 10% ramp: 24h checks: latency, 5xx, token-cost-delta
```
Omar (Solutions): I'll draft a traffic generator (node script) and an eval set focusing on personalization quality regressions. Also add guidelines for embedding batching windows to avoid nightly conflict with peak traffic.
task-bot: ticket created "verdantai-personalization-onboard" assigned to @Ethan @Linh @Omar, due_in: 3 business days.
Ethan (AM): Any renewal risk notes? Current usage is moderate; this is a clear upsell path. Keep an ear out for cost pushback during pricing review.
Nora (CS): No churn signals. Main risks: tail latency and mis-tuned batch windows hitting peak. We'll document mitigation and include Optimize team's recommendations: KV TTL tuning, prefix caching, and model quantization tradeoffs.
Linh (Eng): Technical note: suggest pre-warming embeddings cache 24-48h before traffic cutover and run a dry-run canary with synthetic traffic to validate p95 under load.
Nora (CS): I'll schedule the kickoff with Verdant infra + product for next Tue. Will share the one-pager here before EOD tomorrow. Thanks team :sparkles:
Ethan (AM): I'll post pricing scenarios and renewal pitch here when ready.
Omar (Solutions): Playbook draft ETA 48hrs.
Nora (CS): Closing loop — drop any blockers here.
